title: rtps: Fix Dead Store found by Clang Analyzer
description:
packet-rtps-virtual-transport.c:946:17: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
packet-rtps-virtual-transport.c:995:5: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]

notes.body: @colmenero-rti can you look ?

added 1 commit
  • 36554546 - rtps-virtual-transport: Fix unused variable
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3180/diffs?diff_id=193055969&start_sha=5167f57784356bf9cf8fd9fe0591c4d9ae3071fa)

added 1 commit
  • c81b0413 - rtps-virtual-transport: Fix unused variable
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3180/diffs?diff_id=193058195&start_sha=36554546a97c82f2fe43a29b780fe227c426473c)

Could we add here a comment?
```
    offset += sizeof(guint16); /* parameter length */
```

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3180/diffs?diff_id=193330987&start_sha=c81b041367892a4768ee22d40e263d990fd061a6#c9bb2aab727a260f4dd8251eee4de3ae84c7bfdd_975_975)
You can remove the whole `else` block if you prefer (instead of leaving it empty with the comment).
Done

The changes make sense. I have opened a few captures with them and everything looks good.

Thanks @alagoutte for mentioning me so that I can take a look.

it is ok if i replace sizeof(guint..) by the value ?

Would you prefer me to create a separate merge request, and replace all instances of `sizeof(guint...)` there?
(so that you don't have to go through the trouble of making the changes, whatever is easier for you)
Yes, the idea is create a another MR for this
